body.subject: Codex judge verdict: item48-balances-chain-order-r2 = B
body.text: artifact=item48-balances-chain-order-r2 kind=code purpose=tri7 item 48 round 2 (round 1 was D on two deploy-machinery defects, both now fixed and rehearsed): chain-ordered balances replay in the node + guarded swap/verify/rollback deploy to DNS3, Pi and DNS2; decisions: commit+push to master, and deploy by the brief's section 7 worktree=/tmp/codex-judge-2uY3yB codex_grade=B judge=codex
reasons: The chain-ordered replay implementation is coherent, source hashes match the packaged files, and the supplied test/rehearsal evidence supports the fix.
Both round-1 blocking defects are corrected: the acceptance check handles advancing chains and passes all 15 self-tests, while restart failure is routed through rollback.
The deploy harness passes `bash -n`; the acceptance checker executes successfully in self-test mode.
polish_suggestions: The harness sets `RESTORE_OK=0` when rollback restart fails but never uses it. Its T10 rehearsal therefore reports `outcome=rolled-back` despite logging that the unit did not restart. Either make the final verified active/old-binary state the documented success criterion or emit `ROLLBACK-FAILED` as currently promised.
The brief cites `ev_win_build.txt` as a running release-build record, but that file is absent; remove the reference or include the completed evidence.
The brief still contains stale round-1 filenames (`ev_harness_rehearsal.txt`, `ev_harness_failbranch.txt`) instead of the packaged round-2 evidence filename.
